explanation.example: Scores 0.3 vs 1.1, probability 0.690, loss 0.371, gradient −0.310 for VERB→VERB. Independent output tags versus contextual features; word/subword alignment.

explanation.sections: UD v2 annotation fields; Brants (2000) §3 on known and unknown word accuracy
explanation.example: UPOS 3/4; exact feature bundles 2/4; four of six gold features and six predicted give micro-F1 2/3. Punctuation participates in score denominators according to the protocol.
